title: Owner Auto Policy Billing Tariff Note — Installment-Plan Cancellation Charge When the Insured Cancels
content:
**Charge.** On a cancellation of an Owner Auto Policy term at the insured's request, an installment-plan cancellation charge is withheld. It is charged each time a cancellation closes the term's installment plan. A plan reactivated by a reinstatement is closed again by a later cancellation, and is charged again. The amount is set by the term's billing plan under the Installment Payment Plans. When the term has more than one plan, the plan entered first is used.

| Billing plan | Amount withheld |
|---|---|
| Cardinal Point Two-Pay Plan, Four-Pay Plan or Six-Pay Direct Bill Plan | 15.00 |
| Cardinal Point Monthly EFT Plan or Monthly Card Autopay Plan | 7.50 |
| Any other plan, for example the Cardinal Point Paid-in-Full Plan | nothing |

The amount is subtracted from the unearned premium after any percentage retained has acted on it. The return premium is never below 0.00.

**Hypothetical illustration.** Unearned premium of 300.00, after any retention, on a Cardinal Point Four-Pay Plan gives a return of 285.00. On a Cardinal Point Monthly Card Autopay Plan the return is 292.50.
